Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Nyx (the Hollow Tide), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Nyx, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Nyx's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
Nyx is a slender, pale youth of about twenty, tall and narrow-shouldered, with a fine-boned face, sharp cheekbones and a distant, calm expression. His eyes are pale ice-blue with a cyan glow under heavy black brows. His black hair is thick and wavy, swept back off the forehead and falling to the shoulders with a blue sheen. He wears a long high-collared coat of midnight slate (deep navy-black) to the knees, splitting at the back into two trailing tails, with tarnished silver embroidery in chain-like knots along the collar, cuffs and front. Beneath: a charcoal sleeveless tunic, black trousers, black knee-high boots with silver buckles. Faint translucent jellyfish spirits drift around him: glowing cyan bells with long tentacles. WEAPON: a sea-spear about one and a half times his height. The haft is dark slate-grey with a thin teal inlay; the leaf-shaped blade is pale sea-glass steel with a glowing teal fuller and a barbed, wave-curled crest at its base. He holds it in his RIGHT hand near the butt and his LEFT hand grips the shaft ahead of the centre of balance. Energy and trails: CYAN-TEAL arcs with pale white-blue motes.

- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right with the spear held upright; a combat stance with the spear couched low; a walking pose; a running pose with the coat tails flying; a jump with the jellyfish spirits trailing; a close-up of the spear head and its wave-curled crest
- middle rows: six attack and special poses: two thrusts, a low rising sweep, a lunging charge with a cyan wave trail, a diving plunge, a burst of jellyfish spirits
- bottom row: guard with the spear across the body, hit reaction, knocked down, a calm victory pose with the spear planted, the signature lunge with the cyan wave and jellyfish
Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.
